# tavern-content
The tavern content repo for the tavern-cards workflow on the DeepSeek Harness (dsh): everything that
is content or configuration rather than plugin code, in one clone. Neither package here ships on np
m; the plugins they compose (`@ai4rpg/dsh-tavern-stages`, `@ai4rpg/dsh-stage-switch`, …) install fro
m npm as the preset package's dependencies.
English | 中文
- `tavern-preset/` — `@ai4rpg/dsh-tavern-preset`, the agent preset package: the declared `tavern-sta
ndard` preset, the three tavern skills, the persona prose, the host-plane sidebar row. **The install

entry point** — see `tavern-preset/docs/install-guide.md`.
- `tavern-agents/` — `@ai4rpg/tavern-age
nts`, the four named-subagent personas (CC BY-NC-SA); a generator-time devDependency of the preset p
ackage, with the bodies embedded into the generated patch rather than installed into the profile.
## Install
Hand the content in this section to your AI agent and let it follow along. Doing it by hand works to
o — every command below is copy-paste ready. There are two deployment targets: a command-line profil
e such as `web`, and the `desktop` profile owned by the official desktop client (Electron).
| Target profile | Install |
| `web` and similar (started from a terminal) | `bash install.sh --profile web --verify` — the scrip
t downloads this repo to `~/tavern-content` (an existing checkout is pulled forward instead), then i
nstalls the preset package into the profile, which brings the tavern plugins in from npm as its depe

ndencies. On Windows, run `powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File install.ps1` instead |
| The off
icial desktop client (`desktop`) | Install from inside the app: run `dsh plugin --profile desktop ad
d file:<absolute path to your clone>/tavern-preset` with the client's bundled `dsh` (the **Manage ds
h command…** menu item registers it on `PATH`), or paste the same path into the sidebar **Plugins**
page. From a terminal, `bash install.sh --profile desktop` is the same route: it prepares the checko
ut and runs that bundled `dsh` for you |
After a desktop install, quit the client completely and reopen it — **Tavern Cards** appearing in a
new session's preset chip means it worked. Desktop installs need nothing on your machine: dsh, node,
and pnpm all ship with the app, while a command-line profile just needs dsh itself.
Step-by-step instructions, what success looks like, upgrade and uninstall, and troubleshooting are i
n `tavern-preset/docs/install-guide.md`: the desktop client under “Official desktop client”, command
-line profiles under “Install” and “Verify”. For what gets installed and how to customize it, see `t
avern-preset/README.md`.
Re-running the script updates the checkout and reinstalls; `--remove` uninstalls the preset while ke
eping the checkout. All flags are in the script header.

e its `LICENSE.md`); `tavern-agents` is CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 throughout (see its `LICENSE.md`).
